description: This file contains test classes for verifying the functionality of Orleans grain directory storage and queries across different relational databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL). It includes setup routines, test methods for registration, unregistration, lookup, bulk unregistration, and concurrency testing of grain activation entries.

classes.name: SqlServerRelationalOrleansQueriesTests
classes.description: Test class for Orleans grain directory queries against SQL Server.

classes.name: PostgreSqlRelationalOrleansQueriesTests
classes.description: Test class for Orleans grain directory queries against PostgreSQL.

classes.name: MySqlRelationalOrleansQueriesTests
classes.description: Test class for Orleans grain directory queries against MySQL.

classes.name: RelationalOrleansQueriesTests
classes.description: Abstract base class containing common setup and test routines for Orleans grain directory storage tests across different databases.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Sets up the testing environment, initializing storage and query instances.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Disposes resources after tests are completed.

methods.name: RelationalOrleansQueries_RegistersActivation
methods.description: Tests registration of a grain activation.

methods.name: RelationalOrleansQueries_UnregistersActivation
methods.description: Tests unregistration of a grain activation.

methods.name: RelationalOrleansQueries_LooksUpActivation
methods.description: Tests lookup of a registered grain activation.

methods.name: RelationalOrleansQueries_UnregistersActivationsForSilos
methods.description: Tests bulk unregistration of activations for specific silos.

methods.name: RelationalOrleansQueries_ChaosTest
methods.description: Performs a concurrency stress test involving many parallel registration, lookup, and unregistration calls.
